reviewItem.question: For "From 89.x to 90.x: The control-plane ServiceMonitors (kubelet, kube-apiserver, kube-controller-manager, kube-scheduler, kube-etcd, kube-proxy, coredns…", which environments are exposed? Confirm or correct the exposure condition.

proposed.statement: The chart adds prometheus.serviceAccount.createTokenSecret (default true), which renders a long-lived service-account-token Secret so the control-plane ServiceMonitors can use `authorization` and the kube-root-ca.crt ConfigMap instead of bearerTokenFile/caFile.
